# used tool

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usedTool`](gmeow-usedTool.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usedTool>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/agentic`](../../slices/agentic.md)

The tool that was called — a [`SoftwareAgent`](../classes/gmeow-SoftwareAgent.md) (an MCP tool, a search service, a code runner). Deliberately no Tool subclass: tool-ness is the role the agent plays in this call event, not an identity. Functional: one tool per call; a multi-tool turn is several ToolCalls.
